name: Kerlonian Evershade
summary: At the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, Kerlonian Evershade wakes from a long sleep in the Emerald Dream. The night elf Druid of the Claw needs help crossing the troubled wilds to reach Maestra's Post.

sections.title: Awakening in Darkshore
sections.body: Kerlonian Evershade follows the bear totem as one of the Druids of the Claw. For centuries, these druids slept in barrows and communed with the Emerald Dream. They were called from their slumber during the Third War. Now Kerlonian rests beneath the ancient trees of the Grove of the Ancients, still shaking off the supernatural grogginess of his long sleep. He must travel through Darkshore's troubled forests to reach Maestra's Post on the Ashenvale border.

sections.title: A Treacherous Journey
sections.body: The road from the Grove of the Ancients is dangerous. Blackwood furbolgs prowl the Twilight Vale, while Dark Strand cultists lurk along the road into Ashenvale. Sleep has weakened Kerlonian, and sudden bouts of exhaustion still trouble him. He depends on sympathetic Alliance travelers for protection as he journeys south to rejoin his fellow night elves.

aliases: druid in grove of the ancients
faq.answer: Kerlonian Evershade is a night elf Druid of the Claw near the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore. He recently woke from the Emerald Dream and needs help crossing the woods safely.

faq.q: Why does Kerlonian fall asleep while walking?
faq.answer: Like many Druids of the Claw who slept for centuries in barrow dens, Kerlonian still suffers from the lingering stupor of the Emerald Dream. His body and mind have not fully adjusted to waking, and sudden spells of drowsiness overtake him.

faq.q: Where is he trying to go?
aliases: grove of the ancients escort destination
faq.answer: Kerlonian seeks safe passage south to Maestra's Post, a night elf outpost on the border between Darkshore and Ashenvale, where he can recuperate safely.

faq.q: What is a Druid of the Claw?
aliases: what is druid of the claw
faq.answer: Druids of the Claw are night elf druids who take the shape of the great bear. They channel strength, resilience, and feral might, and traditionally guard barrows and night elf lands while spending ages asleep in the Emerald Dream.

angles.text: As a Druid, you know the toll deep communion with the Emerald Dream can take on Cenarion Circle disciples.
As a night elf, you help safeguard one of your ancient defenders, freshly returned to a world changed since the Third War.
